# Table captions

*Auto-generated by `scripts/generate_paper_assets.py` from saved results. Every asset has its underlying data next to it (CSV/JSON).*

- **`results/tables/tab01_datasets`** — Datasets used in this study (records after validation).
- **`results/tables/tab02_splits`** — Split sizes and label distributions.
- **`results/tables/tab03_data_quality`** — Data-quality and leakage audit (measured).
- **`results/tables/tab04_hyperparameters`** — Model configurations and hyperparameters (shared across models).
- **`results/tables/tab05_results_mc7`** — MC7 (7-way cyberbullying type): test-set results (mean ± s.d. over seeds; ensemble = mean of seed probabilities with bootstrap 95% CI; dedup = test items without near-duplicates in training).
- **`results/tables/tab06_per_class_mc7`** — Per-class results of MuRIL (seed ensemble) on the MC7 test set, with TF-IDF+SVM F1 for reference.
- **`results/tables/tab08_results_mc2`** — MC2 (binary cyberbullying): test-set results (mean ± s.d. over seeds; ensemble = mean of seed probabilities with bootstrap 95% CI; dedup = test items without near-duplicates in training).
- **`results/tables/tab14_results_sarcasm`** — Sarcasm detection (Swami test, hashtags removed): test-set results (mean ± s.d. over seeds; ensemble = mean of seed probabilities with bootstrap 95% CI; dedup = test items without near-duplicates in training).
- **`results/tables/tab07_paired_tests`** — Paired comparisons on the test set (B minus A). Bootstrap: 2,000 paired resamples of the seed-ensemble predictions; McNemar: exact test on per-item correctness. No multiple-comparison correction was applied; treat p-values as descriptive.
- **`results/tables/tab09_legacy_boost`** — Original SACENet additive sarcasm boost (p + 0.18*s if s >= 0.45; threshold 0.55) re-evaluated on MC2 with a trained sarcasm model, compared with the unboosted MuRIL classifier.
- **`results/tables/tab10_external`** — Cross-dataset evaluation without any re-training or threshold tuning. Label constructs differ from the training task (offensive language; differently sourced sarcasm), so these numbers measure transfer, not in-domain performance.
- **`results/tables/tab11_error_slices`** — Error analysis by heuristic slice (MuRIL seed ensemble, MC7 test).
- **`results/tables/tab11b_top_confusions`** — Most frequent confusions (MuRIL seed ensemble, MC7 test).
- **`results/tables/tab03b_split_shift`** — Domain-classifier test of distribution shift (TF-IDF LR, 5-fold CV ROC-AUC; 0.5 = indistinguishable).
- **`results/tables/tab05b_mc7_subsets`** — MC7 macro-F1 by evaluation subset: validation (in-distribution), full official test, test items with a near-duplicate in training, and the de-duplicated remainder (mean ± s.d. over seeds).
- **`results/tables/tab12_runtime_size`** — Model size, inference latency and training time (Apple M1 Pro).
- **`results/tables/tab13_early_detection`** — Early-warning proxy evaluation on CONDA test conversations (running-max policy; thresholds chosen on validation).
- **`results/tables/tab15_explainability`** — SHAP faithfulness, stability and overhead (MuRIL, MC7).
